definitions.explanation: A large group of fish swimming together. A written and technical word, common in fishing, marine science and news; in conversation, {魚|さかな}の{群|む}れ is more usual.

examples.japanese: {魚群|ぎょぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: We found a school of fish.
The fishing boat headed offshore, following the school of fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{釣|つ}り{船|ぶね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{魚群探知機|ぎょぐんたんちき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: Fishing boats these days use a fish finder to locate where the fish are.

notes:
Composed of {魚|ぎょ} (fish) and ⟦{群|ぐん}→群：02790_gun⟧ (group, flock).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魚群|ぎょぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧: to follow a school of fish
- {魚群|ぎょぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧: to find a school of fish
- {魚群探知機|ぎょぐんたんちき}: fish finder (sonar), often shortened to {魚探|ぎょたん}

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧: group, flock, school — the everyday word for any animals moving together (⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧, ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧)
